description: Drainage Pit is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Canning. Shows location of Drainage Pits within the City of Canning and is provided for information only. This data set is presented as points. Coverage: City of Canning. The portal files it under the publisher City of Canning. Its tags are Drainage, Open Data, city of Canning. It offers 2 resource(s) in .zip shapefile, file geodatabase, mapinfo mid/mif, geojson. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
